headline: Revenue and margins hit records as all end markets grow
summary_short: Analog Devices reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3.62B, up 37.2% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.40, more than double y/y, as gross margin expanded 630bps to 67.3%.
summary_long: Revenue rose 14.7% q/q and 37.2% y/y to $3.62B, with growth across all end markets led by Communications (+79% y/y) and Industrial (+56% y/y, 50% of revenue); Automotive grew just 2% y/y. GAAP gross margin expanded 630bps y/y to 67.3% and operating margin rose 1,240bps to 38.1%, driving GAAP diluted EPS of $2.40 (+111% y/y) and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.09 (+67% y/y). ADI returned $1.3B to shareholders via dividends and buybacks in the quarter and declared a $1.10/share dividend. For Q3 FY2026, ADI guided revenue of $3.9B ±$100M, adjusted operating margin of ~49.0%, and adjusted EPS of $3.30 ±$0.15.

drivers.explanation: Growth was broad-based across all four end markets, led by Communications (+79% y/y) and Industrial (+56% y/y, 50% of revenue); record Q2 bookings across Industrial, Automotive, and Communications B2B markets.
GAAP EPS grew far faster than revenue on margin expansion; adjusted diluted EPS of $3.09 excludes acquisition-related amortization and special charges per management's non-GAAP reconciliation.

Results came in above the high end of Q2 outlook on record demand and operational discipline; management guided Q3 FY2026 revenue of $3.9B, adjusted operating margin near 49.0%, and adjusted EPS of $3.30.
